From 9da4f9964abcaeb6e19797d5e3b10faad338a786 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Alex Deucher <alexander.deucher@amd.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Mar 2026 12:33:48 -0400
Subject: [PATCH] drm/amd/display: check if ext_caps is valid in BL setup

LVDS connectors don't have extended backlight caps so check
if the pointer is valid before accessing it.

Closes: https://gitlab.freedesktop.org/drm/amd/-/issues/5012
Fixes: 1454642960b0 ("drm/amd: Re-introduce property to control adaptive backlight modulation")
Cc: Mario Limonciello <mario.limonciello@amd.com>
Reviewed-by: Mario Limonciello (AMD) <superm1@kernel.org>
Signed-off-by: Alex Deucher <alexander.deucher@amd.com>
(cherry picked from commit 3f797396d7f4eb9bb6eded184bbc6f033628a6f6)
Cc: stable@vger.kernel.org

diff --git a/drivers/gpu/drm/amd/display/amdgpu_dm/amdgpu_dm.c b/drivers/gpu/drm/amd/display/amdgpu_dm/amdgpu_dm.c
index acc3d8dad4a3..2328c1aa0ead 100644
--- a/drivers/gpu/drm/amd/display/amdgpu_dm/amdgpu_dm.c
+++ b/drivers/gpu/drm/amd/display/amdgpu_dm/amdgpu_dm.c
@@ -5423,7 +5423,7 @@ static void setup_backlight_device(struct amdgpu_display_manager *dm,
 	caps = &dm->backlight_caps[aconnector->bl_idx];
 
 	/* Only offer ABM property when non-OLED and user didn't turn off by module parameter */
-	if (!caps->ext_caps->bits.oled && amdgpu_dm_abm_level < 0)
+	if (caps->ext_caps && !caps->ext_caps->bits.oled && amdgpu_dm_abm_level < 0)
 		drm_object_attach_property(&aconnector->base.base,
 					   dm->adev->mode_info.abm_level_property,
 					   ABM_SYSFS_CONTROL);
-- 
2.34.1

The patch modifies a single file to fix a potential NULL pointer dereference when setting up the backlight device for LVDS connectors.

**File:** `drivers/gpu/drm/amd/display/amdgpu_dm/amdgpu_dm.c`

**Modification:**  
In the `setup_backlight_device` function, the condition for attaching the ABM (Adaptive Brightness Management) property was updated. The original code directly accessed `caps->ext_caps->bits.oled` without checking if `caps->ext_caps` was valid. The fix adds a check for `caps->ext_caps` being non-NULL before accessing its members.

- **Before:**  
  `if (!caps->ext_caps->bits.oled && amdgpu_dm_abm_level < 0)`
- **After:**  
  `if (caps->ext_caps && !caps->ext_caps->bits.oled && amdgpu_dm_abm_level < 0)`

**Relationship:**  
The change ensures that the code only attempts to read `bits.oled` from `ext_caps` when the pointer is valid. This prevents a crash on LVDS displays, which do not provide extended backlight capabilities, thus resolving the bug reported in the issue tracker.

The code statements that lead to the bug are:
`if (!caps->ext_caps->bits.oled && amdgpu_dm_abm_level < 0)`
Reason:
The code accesses `caps->ext_caps->bits.oled` without verifying that `caps->ext_caps` is not NULL. For LVDS connectors, extended backlight capabilities are not present, so `ext_caps` is NULL, leading to a NULL pointer dereference and a crash.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
`if (caps->ext_caps && !caps->ext_caps->bits.oled && amdgpu_dm_abm_level < 0)`
Reason:
The fix adds a NULL check for `caps->ext_caps` before accessing its `bits.oled` member. This prevents the NULL pointer dereference when the connector lacks extended backlight capabilities (e.g., LVDS).
